CheckInstanceDatasource.description_en: Tests connectivity to a data source

CheckModelFeatureFGFeature.description_en: Verify that the FG configuration is correct and meets all rules
CheckModelFeatureFGFeature.description_zh: 检查FG配置内容是否正确，是否满足所有规则

CreateDatasource.description_en: Registers a datasource in a FeatureStore instance. A datasource provides offline or online storage for a project
CreateDatasource.description_zh: 在 FeatureStore 实例下注册数据源。数据源为项目提供离线或在线存储

CreateFeatureEntity.description_en: Creates a feature entity. A feature entity defines a join key that links multiple feature views to it, enabling feature joining
CreateFeatureEntity.description_zh: 创建特征实体。特征实体定义关联键，多个特征视图通过关联键关联到同一特征实体，实现特征拼接

CreateFeatureView.description_en: Creates a feature view. Three types of feature views are supported: batch, stream, and behavior sequence. A feature view defines the feature structure through fields and is associated with a feature entity
CreateFeatureView.description_zh: 创建特征视图，支持创建离线、实时、行为序列三种类型的特征视图。特征视图通过字段定义特征结构，并关联到特征实体

CreateInstance.description_en: Creates a FeatureStore instance. This operation is idempotent. If an instance is already running or initializing in the same account, this operation returns the existing instance ID
CreateInstance.description_zh: 创建 FeatureStore 实例。同一账号下已存在运行中或初始化中的实例时，返回已有实例 ID（幂等）

CreateLLMConfig.description_en: Creates an LLM configuration that contains the call parameters and API key for an embedding model. During creation, the service validates the ApiKey and Model. For a DashScope model, the EmbeddingDimension must match one of the fixed, valid dimensions supported by the model
CreateLLMConfig.description_zh: 创建 LLM 调用配置，配置 Embedding 模型的调用参数和密钥。创建时会验证 ApiKey 和 Model 是否可用，DashScope 模型的 EmbeddingDimension 需符合模型固定的合法维度

CreateLabelTable.description_en: Creates a label table. A label table defines the schema for label data referenced by model features
CreateLabelTable.description_zh: 创建 Label 表。Label 表定义标签数据的表结构，供模型特征引用

CreateModelFeature.description_en: Creates a model feature. A model feature associates a label table with a set of feature view fields to generate the training dataset table required for model training and to specify the feature set used for model inference
CreateModelFeature.description_zh: 创建模型特征。模型特征关联一张 Label 表和一组特征视图字段，用于生成模型训练所需的训练集表和指定模型推理使用的特征集合

CreateProject.description_en: Creates a FeatureStore project. A project is a container for feature entities, feature views, and model features
CreateProject.description_zh: 创建 FeatureStore 项目。项目是特征实体、特征视图、模型特征的容器

CreateServiceIdentityRole.description_en: Creates a service-linked role that authorizes the FeatureStore service to access other cloud resources of the user. Returns a conflict error if the role already exists
CreateServiceIdentityRole.description_zh: 创建服务关联角色，授权 FeatureStore 服务访问用户的其他云资源。角色已存在时返回冲突错误

DeleteDatasource.description_en: Deletes a datasource from a FeatureStore instance
DeleteDatasource.description_zh: 从 FeatureStore 实例中删除数据源

DeleteFeatureView.description_en: Deletes a feature view. A feature view cannot be deleted if it is referenced by a model feature. To delete the feature view, you must first delete the associated model feature
DeleteFeatureView.description_zh: 删除特征视图。被模型特征引用的特征视图无法删除，需先删除关联的模型特征

DeleteLLMConfig.description_en: Deletes an LLM call configuration. You cannot delete a configuration referenced by a feature view. You must first delete the associated feature view
DeleteLLMConfig.description_zh: 删除 LLM 调用配置。被特征视图引用的配置无法删除，需先删除关联的特征视图

DeleteLabelTable.description_en: Deletes a label table. You cannot delete a label table that is referenced by a model feature. Delete the associated model feature first
DeleteLabelTable.description_zh: 删除 Label 表。被模型特征引用的 Label 表无法删除，需先删除关联的模型特征

DeleteModelFeature.description_en: Deletes a model feature and its associated training set table
DeleteModelFeature.description_zh: 删除模型特征，同时删除关联的训练集表

ExportModelFeatureTrainingSetTable.description_en: Export a training set table for model features. Create an export task by configuring the Label table input, the data source partition for each feature view, and the training set output partition
ExportModelFeatureTrainingSetTable.description_zh: 导出模型特征的训练集表。配置 Label 表输入、各特征视图的数据源分区和训练集输出分区，创建导出任务

GetDatasource.description_en: Gets the detailed information about a data source, including its type, connection information, and configuration
GetDatasource.description_zh: 获取数据源详细信息，包括类型、连接信息和配置

GetDatasourceTable.description_en: Gets the field information for a specified table in a data source. This operation supports only MaxCompute data sources
GetDatasourceTable.description_zh: 获取数据源中指定表的字段信息。仅支持 MaxCompute 类型数据源

GetFeatureEntity.description_en: Retrieves the details of a feature entity
GetFeatureEntity.description_zh: 获取特征实体详细信息

GetFeatureView.description_en: Retrieves detailed information about a feature view, including field definitions, data source bindings, and synchronization status
GetFeatureView.description_zh: 获取特征视图详细信息，包括字段定义、数据源绑定和同步状态

GetInstance.description_en: Retrieves the details of a FeatureStore instance
GetInstance.description_zh: 获取 FeatureStore 实例详细信息

GetLLMConfig.description_en: Retrieves the details of an LLM call configuration
GetLLMConfig.description_zh: 查询 LLM 调用配置详情

GetLabelTable.description_en: Retrieves the details of a label table, including its field definitions and related models
GetLabelTable.description_zh: 获取 Label 表详细信息，包括字段定义和关联模型

GetModelFeature.description_en: Gets detailed information about a model feature, including the selected feature list, lineage relations, and training set export script
GetModelFeature.description_zh: 获取模型特征详细信息，包括所选特征列表、血缘关系和训练集导出脚本

GetModelFeatureFGFeature.description_en: Retrieves the Feature Generation (FG) feature configuration of a model feature
GetModelFeatureFGFeature.description_zh: 获取模型特征的FG特征配置信息

GetModelFeatureFGInfo.description_en: Retrieves the fg.json file configuration for a model feature
GetModelFeatureFGInfo.description_zh: 获取模型特征的fg.json文件配置信息

GetProject.description_en: Gets the details of a project, including its data source bindings and resource counts
GetProject.description_zh: 获取项目详细信息，包括数据源绑定和资源计数

GetProjectFeatureEntity.description_en: Retrieve details of a feature entity in a project by name
GetProjectFeatureEntity.description_zh: 根据名称，获取项目下指定特征实体的详细信息

GetServiceIdentityRole.description_en: Queries the details of a service-linked role and verifies whether the role exists and is available
GetServiceIdentityRole.description_zh: 查询服务关联角色详情，验证角色是否存在且可用

GetTask.description_en: Gets the details of an asynchronous task

ListDatasourceFeatureViews.description_en: Retrieve all feature view information from the data source
ListDatasourceFeatureViews.description_zh: 获取数据源下所有特征视图信息

ListDatasourceTables.description_en: Lists the tables in a datasource. This operation supports only MaxCompute datasources
ListDatasourceTables.description_zh: 列出数据源中的表。仅支持 MaxCompute 类型数据源

ListDatasources.description_en: Lists the data sources in a FeatureStore instance. You can filter the results by workspace, type, and name
ListDatasources.description_zh: 列出 FeatureStore 实例下的数据源，支持按工作空间、类型和名称过滤

ListFeatureEntities.description_en: Lists the feature entities in a FeatureStore instance. You can filter the results by project, name, owner, and parent feature entity
ListFeatureEntities.description_zh: 列出 FeatureStore 实例下的特征实体，支持按项目、名称、所有者和父特征实体过滤

ListFeatureViewFieldRelationships.description_en: Retrieves the relationships for a specific field in a feature view, returning a list of models that reference the field and the names of the associated online and offline tables
ListFeatureViewFieldRelationships.description_zh: 查询特征视图指定字段的血缘关系，返回引用该字段的模型特征列表及在线/离线表名

ListFeatureViewOnlineFeatures.description_en: Retrieves online features from a feature view based on one or more join IDs. For each join ID provided, the operation returns the corresponding feature fields as key-value pairs
ListFeatureViewOnlineFeatures.description_zh: 根据 Join ID 查询特征视图的在线特征数据，返回每个 Join ID 对应的特征字段键值对

ListFeatureViewRelationships.description_en: Lists the relationships for a feature view, including the models that reference it
ListFeatureViewRelationships.description_zh: 查询特征视图的血缘关系，返回引用该特征视图的模型特征列表

ListFeatureViews.description_en: Lists feature views, filterable by project, name, type, tag, and feature name
ListFeatureViews.description_zh: 列出特征视图，支持按项目、名称、类型、标签和特征名过滤

ListInstances.description_en: Lists FeatureStore instances in the current account. You can filter the instances by status
ListInstances.description_zh: 列出当前账号下的 FeatureStore 实例，支持按状态过滤

ListLLMConfigs.description_zh: 查询 LLM 调用配置列表

ListLabelTables.description_en: Lists label tables, filterable by project, name, owner, and ID
ListLabelTables.description_zh: 列出 Label 表，支持按项目、名称、所有者和 ID 过滤

ListModelFeatureAvailableFeatures.description_en: Lists the available features for a model feature when you register a feature group (FG)
ListModelFeatureAvailableFeatures.description_zh: 获取注册FG特征时模型特征下可选的所有特征

ListModelFeatures.description_en: Lists model features, with sorting, pagination, and filtering by project, name, creator, and ID
ListModelFeatures.description_zh: 列出模型特征，支持按项目、名称、创建人和 ID 过滤，支持排序和分页

ListProjectFeatureViews.description_en: Lists all feature views and their available features in a project. Use this operation to select feature views and features for the CreateModelFeature and UpdateModelFeature operations
ListProjectFeatureViews.description_zh: 列出项目下所有特征视图及其可选的特征字段，用于为 CreateModelFeature 和 UpdateModelFeature 选取特征视图和字段

ListProjectFeatures.description_en: Lists all features in a project. This operation supports filtering by name, alias, and feature view, as well as sorting and pagination. The response includes the data type, parent feature view, and the number of model features that reference each feature
ListProjectFeatures.description_zh: 检索项目下所有特征字段，支持按名称、别名和特征视图过滤，支持排序和分页。返回结果包含每个特征的类型、所属特征视图和被模型特征引用的次数

ListProjects.description_en: Lists projects in a Feature Store instance, filterable by name, workspace, and owner
ListProjects.description_zh: 列出 FeatureStore 实例下的项目，支持按名称、工作空间和所有者过滤

ListTaskLogs.description_en: Lists the execution logs of an asynchronous task. This operation supports pagination
ListTaskLogs.description_zh: 获取异步任务的执行日志，支持分页

ListTasks.description_en: Lists asynchronous tasks for an instance, supporting pagination and filtering by project, object type, and status
ListTasks.description_zh: 列出实例下的异步任务，支持按项目、对象类型、状态等条件过滤，支持分页

PublishFeatureViewTable.description_en: Creates a data synchronization task to synchronize data from a feature view's offline table to its online store
PublishFeatureViewTable.description_zh: 创建特征视图的数据同步任务，把离线表数据同步到对应的在线存储

StopTask.description_en: Stops an asynchronous task. You can only stop tasks in the Initializing or Running state
StopTask.description_zh: 停止异步任务。仅 Initializing 或 Running 状态的任务可以停止

UpdateDatasource.description_en: Updates information for a data source. Its type and workspace cannot be changed
UpdateDatasource.description_zh: 更新数据源信息。数据源类型和工作空间不可更改

UpdateLLMConfig.description_en: Updates the large language model (LLM) call configuration. If you do not specify the `ApiKey` parameter, the existing key is retained. After the update, the system revalidates the model's availability and its parameters
UpdateLLMConfig.description_zh: 更新 LLM 调用配置。ApiKey 不传则保留原有密钥，更新时会重新验证模型可用性和参数合法性

UpdateLabelTable.description_en: Updates the attributes of fields in a label table. You can modify the attributes of existing fields, but you cannot add or delete fields, or change field names and types
UpdateLabelTable.description_zh: 更新 Label 表字段属性。只能修改已有字段的属性，不能新增、删除字段或修改字段名和类型

UpdateModelFeature.description_en: Updates the information of a model feature, including the associated label table, selected feature fields, and conflict priority policy. The update performs a full replacement. The specified Features overwrite the existing values
UpdateModelFeature.description_zh: 更新模型特征的信息，包括关联的 Label 表、所选特征字段和冲突优先级策略。更新为全量替换，传入的 Features 会覆盖已有值

UpdateModelFeatureFGFeature.description_en: Update the FG feature configuration for a model feature
UpdateModelFeatureFGFeature.description_zh: 更新模型特征的FG特征配置信息

UpdateProject.description_en: Updates the description of a project

WriteFeatureViewTable.description_en: Imports data from a URL to the offline table of a feature view. This is an asynchronous operation
WriteFeatureViewTable.description_zh: 从 URL 导入数据到特征视图的离线表，异步执行
